prompt: A sea-witch in flowing cerulean and sapphire robes stands facing the viewer on a rain-slicked stone pier, both arms raised, conjuring three distinct manifestations of tide-magic at once: to her left a curling cresting wave sweeps a small struggling fish-creature backward off its feet (bounce); above her hands a glowing arcane spell-sigil cracks and shatters into shards, snuffed out by spray (counter); to her right a still pool of water reflects two glowing playing-card shapes like a vision of the future (foresee). Foam, sea-spray and droplets fill the air. The background is a stormy teal twilight sea and dark clouds.

A blue-robed tide mage in side profile facing south-west, hood up, one hand thrust forward unleashing a powerful curling wall of cerulean seawater that crashes into a small green frog-creature and sweeps it backward into the air, returning it whence it came. Glowing droplets and foam spray everywhere. The mages other hand cups a small swirling whirlpool that reflects faint glimpses of arcane cards. The background is a moonlit stormy ocean horizon under wine-purple clouds.
